'''Enhanced Premiere''' is the 19th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in November 1998. It is six die-cut packs, each with one premium character visible through the window plus four [[Premiere Unlimited]] boosters. MSRP $14.95 per pack; 12 packs per box. CardGuide numbering: 19th product.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

The six premiums are [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber]], [[Luke With Lightsaber]], [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]], [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]], and [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]]. Early boxes were uneven (3 Vader, 3 Luke, 2 Boba Fett, 2 Obi-Wan, 1 Han, 1 Leia); later even-split boxes (2 of each, for EPP Overdrive) have a #414 Custom Display sticker on the bottom. The four Unlimited Premiere packs in each box are reprints and are not listed.<ref name="encyc" />
